skill.summary: Token-efficient task orchestration system that delegates work to specialized subordinates while prioritizing system-level solutions over AI inference.

latestVersion.changelog:
Major update: Full orchestration platform modules added.

- Introduced new scripts for auto-routing, batch processing, caching, A2A mesh, error recovery, learning engine, and scheduler integration.
- Added README documentation for setup and usage.
- Expanded functionality to support intelligent routing, result caching, parallel execution, robust error handling, inter-agent communication, and adaptive learning.
- Achieves 90%+ token reduction and platform-wide task orchestration with new modular design.
